name: Navigate from the hero to selected work
description: Verifies the main portfolio navigation takes a visitor from the hero to the work section.
steps: Select the Explore my work link
expected: The page navigates to the selected work section and the Genevieve Goings case study is visible.

name: Open and use the mobile navigation
description: Verifies the navigation menu is usable on a narrow mobile viewport.
steps: Open the portfolio at mobile width
Open the navigation menu again and close it
expected: The mobile menu opens, the About section is reached, and the menu can be opened and closed without layout overflow.

name: Validate and submit a project enquiry
description: Verifies required contact fields are enforced and a complete enquiry is prepared for WhatsApp.
steps: Navigate to the project enquiry form
Submit the form with required fields empty
Enter a name, valid email and project message
expected: The empty form is blocked with required-field validation; a completed enquiry opens a WhatsApp message containing the submitted details.

name: Use the contact links on a mobile device
covers: WhatsApp and discovery call contact paths
description: Verifies the contact section exposes working external contact destinations on mobile.
steps: Return and select the discovery call link
expected: The WhatsApp link points to the supplied business contact and the discovery call link points to the supplied Calendly booking page.
